explicit_items.not_included: blocked footings; straps / ground beams (their blinding is not dimensioned for straps)

explicit_items.why: no footing-top / founding level and no ground-beam or ground-slab level is printed in the structural source (typical footing detail p.13 dimensions none); +1.00 FFL is corroboration only

the GROUND BEAMS plan carries no beam tags; p.13 gives typical sections by length (30x60 > 5 m, 30x40 < 5 m, 30x30, exterior 30 x 'FOLLOW ARCH.') whose exterior depth needs the outer ground level to the ground-slab level - not proved
no ground-slab thickness / outline is printed (the details show 'Ground Floor slab level' only)
waist thickness and riser height not printed
no structural (shear / retaining) wall is tagged on any plan; the 'B.W' schedule row (20 x 60) is bound to no plan occurrence
DETAIL OF SWIMMING POOL is a section detail (N.T.S.) with no plan extent bound to it

rule: physical total never double counts; gross beam view reported separately; blocked components excluded and listed
